subject: fractions
title: Fractions from the ground up
goal: Add, multiply and divide fractions and explain why each rule works

concepts.title: What a fraction is
concepts.summary: A fraction names equal parts of a whole.

concepts.title: Equivalent fractions
concepts.summary: Different fractions can name the same amount.

concepts.title: Comparing fractions
concepts.summary: Decide which of two fractions is larger.

concepts.title: Adding fractions
concepts.summary: Add fractions by first giving them the same size parts.

concepts.title: Multiplying fractions
concepts.summary: Take a fraction of a fraction.

concepts.title: Dividing fractions
concepts.summary: Ask how many of one fraction fit into another.
